newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-WEEKEND GAMES IN THE SPANISH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND GAMES IN THE SPANISH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Matches scheduled in the Spanish league championship this weekend.
Playing Saturday:
Espanyol (15) vs Valencia (9) kick off 1830 gmt
Two sides who qualified for Europe last season end a poor campaign with nothing left to play for.
Real Betis (4) vs Valladolid (7) 2000
Betis have been destabilised by the turmoil surrounding the future of coach Lorenzo Serra Ferrer ahead of June 28's Cup final, while Valladolid are still celebrating clinching a UEFA Cup place.
Playing Sunday:
Rayo Vallecano (18) vs Barcelona (2) 1700
Barcelona have been rocked by internal dissent and friction in training before the game against Rayo, one of four teams still struggling against either relegation or the relegation play-off.
Celta Vigo (17) vs Real Madrid (1) 1700
Keeper Bodo Illgner may lose his place to Santiago Canizares, a former Celta player. Celta need a win against the champions to ensure they are not relegated.
Deportivo Coruna (3) vs Extremadura (19) 1700

Deportivo have only 12 first-team players fit to play, but their request for a postponement has been ignored, while Extremadura have offered legs of ham as incentives to the opponents of their rivals in the relegation zone.
Oviedo (16) vs Sporting Gijon (14) 1700
Defeat in the Asturian derby could leave Oviedo in the relegation play-off. The home side hope to have Portuguese defender Abel Xabier fit for the game.
Hercules (21) vs Athletic Bilbao (6) 1700
Athletic Bilbao clinched Spain's last UEFA Cup slot on Monday, while Hercules were condemend to relegation weeks ago.
Zaragoza (12) vs Compostela (13) 1700
Compostela's Fabiano Soares is doubtful for the game because of injury, while team mate Lyuboslav Penev could be dropped because of repeated indiscipline. Neither side have anything to play for.
Racing Santander (11) vs Sevilla (20) 1700
Another match with just pride at stake. For relegation-bound Sevilla the match will be the last in club colours for a posse of players.
Real Sociedad (8) vs Logrones (22) 1700

Real have six key players missing, but saw any chance of a UEFA Cup place disappear earlier in the week. Logrones have been thinking more of their second division future than first division present for over two months.
playing Monday:
Atletico Madrid (5) vs Tenerife (10) 1930

The Tenerife board has been upset by Jupp Heynckes, who looks set to sign for Real Madrid, and may yet ban the German coach from sitting on the bench in Atletico's Vicente Calderon stadium. Slavisa Jokanovic also looks set to leave the club.
